from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TransactionalFinancialAssetsData(BaseModel):
    """A company's reported transactional financial assets for a reporting period."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code/stock ticker")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. 2024年第一季度")
    transactional_financial_assets_ending: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of transactional financial assets (期末余额)")
    transactional_financial_assets_beginning: float | None = Field(description="Beginning balance of transactional financial assets (期初余额)")
    change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Percentage change from beginning to ending, if reported")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason for change, if stated")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document referencing the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data: list[TransactionalFinancialAssetsData]
